analysis:
Portfolio is already at maximum target concentration (5/5 positions) with negative available cash (-$38,966), meaning the book is running on margin. Total deployed value across APP, MCO, MSFT, UBER, V exceeds equity. Adding a 6th position would deepen leverage further — that contradicts the strategy's core risk discipline.

Existing positions are in reasonable shape: APP (+8%), V (+5%), MSFT (+4%) are working. MCO is essentially flat but is a high-quality compounder deserving patience. UBER is flat and warrants monitoring — it is absent from the screened candidate list, suggesting possible trend or quality deterioration; thesis should be reviewed on next earnings.

Scanning the 30 screened candidates for new entries: The best quality-basing setups are AMP (fwd P/E 9.89, ROE 67%, 37% of 52w range, basing), IQV (PEG 0.70, fwd P/E 12.18, 33% range), and AIG (PEG 0.64, fwd P/E 8.82, 47% range). These are genuinely interesting but adding any of them now would require either (a) selling a current winner early, or (b) adding more margin — neither is warranted when the existing book is performing. The semiconductor runners (MU +38% vs SMA50, WDC +26% vs SMA50, NXPI +27% vs SMA50) are explicitly excluded by the late-cycle extension rule (range_position >80%, far above SMA50). SNPS and ADSK have earnings in 8-9 days — too risky to initiate ahead of binary events.

Decision: 0 new trades. Hold current 5 positions. Let winners run. Monitor UBER closely — if it breaks below its entry stop it should be the first position closed to reduce margin and free capital for a fresher AMP or IQV setup on a confirmed basing entry. Cash preservation and leverage reduction take priority over chasing new ideas at this stage.
